channels.number_policy: Observed input values only; program normalization precedes extraction. SEC evidence is separate.

stages.name: text/transcript obtained with source offsets
stages.reason: original text and character offsets retained

stages.name: program verdict
stages.reason: 0/0 accepted claims have program checks; insufficient evidence is a verdict

stages.name: timestamp and speaker attribution
stages.reason: text/images do not establish who spoke; a sampled frame time is not speech attribution

coverage.note: Counts describe extracted claim rows, not unique facts or all input assertions. Full-content recall is unknown without an independently labeled denominator. Program-checked includes insufficient-evidence verdicts and does not mean supported.
